noveltyJustification: This pass traced the headline keep result to the miss-only sampling rule and paired discordance math, and separated that conditional result from prevalence in the built-in profile.
focus: Reconstruct the 24-row result from the sampling rule, baseline construction, paired metrics, and keep gates; distinguish conditional miss accuracy from real reviewer traffic.

keyFindings.label: The measured set is conditioned on regex misses, and its balanced labels make the zero-call majority baseline 8/24.
Jev was right on all 24 labeled outputs; it beat the selected baseline on 16 discordant rows, lost on none, and did not flip across the three option orders.
p_win is the exact one-sided sign-test tail over the 16 paired disagreements, not a confidence interval for production accuracy.
The Jev arm plans three judgments for each miss plus one auth call; the 24-row run therefore plans 73 calls, while the target feature spec documents 8/8 built-in fixture cases as regex hits.
